name: abdm-portal
description: The ABDM Developer Portal: integration skills for ABDM, UHI and NHCX integrators, one plugin per gateway, and the contributor's assistant for building the portal itself

plugins.name: abdm-integrators-assistant
plugins.description: Build and debug an ABDM integration. One skill per module, gateway, M1 to M4 on the provider side, P1 to P4 inside a PHR application, Scan and Register, Scan and Pay, Record Share and FHIR, each with scaffold, integrate and debug references. Three agents plan above them: an integration agent that sequences skills toward a goal, a call debugger that takes one failing call to a fix proved by the original call succeeding, and a FHIR compliance agent that validates bundles against the Docs MCP validator.

plugins.name: nhcx
plugins.description: Build the provider side of an NHCX claims integration into a hospital information system. nhcx-full builds it end to end; one skill per use case builds coverage, pre-authorisation, claim, communication, payment or reprocess on its own. Each finds what the system already has, builds only what is missing, and connects the nhcx-docs MCP server for live answers.

plugins.name: uhi-integrators-assistant
plugins.description: Build and debug a UHI integration, one skill per service: Physical Consultation, Ambulance Booking, PM-JAY HEM hospital discovery, Blood Bank, Jan Aushadhi and NOTTO. Each carries scaffold, design, integrate, debug and test references for an EUA, or an HSPA where the service is open to one. Two agents plan above them: an integration agent that picks the role and sequences the service skills toward a goal, and a call debugger that takes one failing call or missing callback to a fix proved by the original step succeeding.

plugins.name: abdm-contributors-assistant
plugins.description: Build and operate the ABDM Developer Portal: atom authoring, verification, linting, OpenAPI ingestion, Scalar docs, skill compilation, the update pipeline, the support agent, planning and proof. Compiled from the architecture and execution plan in this repo.
